about: Krasner Law works from Park Avenue with a second office in Jersey City, and names eight people with no role beside any of them.

551 reviews across the two listings, 413 of them in Manhattan. It explains eight stages of a matrimonial case, from the net worth statement through discovery and a custody evaluation to trial. Its own fees page redirects to the home page, so there is nothing on it to read.

subs.label: Fee terms published
subs.evidence: Nothing about the rate, the retainer or any other price on the 14 pages we read. The court rules guarantee a client all of it in a signed agreement before the work starts; publishing it beforehand is the firm's choice
